description: A Node.js script that analyzes TypeScript project files to verify that plugin SDK subpath imports are properly exported in package.json and entrypoints JSON, reporting violations if any are missing.

methods.name: readPackageExports
methods.description: Reads package.json exports and filters for plugin-sdk subpaths.

methods.name: readEntrypoints
methods.description: Reads plugin SDK entrypoints JSON and filters out 'index'.

methods.name: parsePluginSdkSubpath
methods.description: Extracts subpath from a specifier if it starts with 'openclaw/plugin-sdk/'.

methods.name: compareEntries
methods.description: Comparison function for sorting violation entries.

methods.name: collectViolations
methods.description: Main logic to collect and return violations of missing plugin SDK exports.

methods.name: main
methods.description: Executes violation collection and outputs results, exits with code 1 if violations found.
